title: Quentin and the House
author: Vesper Yarrow
blurb: Sable Thornbury, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the harvest moon rises.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
